描述_EN: when the owners died their pendants were buried with them. carved jade dragons or birds were worn as pendants in ancient china. this piece in the form of a coiled dragon was made in the 12th-11th century bc, by which time jade carvers usually added more details to the surface.
描述_ZN: 当主人死后，他们的吊坠被埋葬在一起。 在中国古代，雕刻的玉龙或玉鸟被作为挂件佩戴。 这件盘龙的作品是在公元前12-11世纪制作的，那时的玉雕师通常会在表面添加更多的细节。
